body.statement: Fix \(\eta>0\). Uniformly over \((\mu_0,\mu_1)\in\mathcal M_{L,\eta}\), if both confidence radii do not exceed \(\eta/(4L)\), then \[\Pr(\widehat S\neq S^\star)\leq4L\exp\!\left\{-\frac{n_{\min}\eta^2}{8L^2}\right\}.\] Under stable allocation this bound converges to zero. The conclusion requires no unique Hall cut or separation among active rectangles.
body.justification: The result separates honest coverage at boundaries from exact selector recovery on a transparent regular class.
body.gap: FangSantos2019 analyzes directionally differentiable functionals and HuangFangHanleyRosenblum2019 a scalar optimizer; this theorem controls a discontinuous lexicographic set selector.
body.consumer: Repeated randomized studies with a fixed ordinal endpoint recover the same population reporting set whenever the identified margins stay off feasibility boundaries.
